thread:
anna: quick follow-up from today's RFC session about handshake + retry surface. i want to lock a few operational rules around resume, chunk dedupe, and migration before we finalize the doc.

lee: go ahead. main open items i remember: how aggressive is resume acceptance, what metadata proxy must keep, and what we surface to SDKs.

anna: right. proposal summary: keep proxy intentionally lightweight (no full model pins). handshake carries: session id, resume-token (checkpoint + offset + compat tag), small routing hint (family+quant), nonce for cheap dedupe validation, and a short trace id. proxies can accept resume only if compat tag matches or is explicitly compatible.

omar: about the nonce/dedupe: i prefer a local HMAC-based nonce (session + counter) so proxy can cheaply detect duplicate retries without contacting control plane. full idempotency is still a backend concern.

lee: sounds fine, but billing concerns remain. proxy best-effort dedupe could hide duplicates from downstream billing. we need a reconciliation signal.

anna: plan: every dedupe decision emits an audit event with session id + resume-token + decision=deduped|forwarded and we tag ambiguous drops with X-RW-UNSURE-DEDUP. billing will correlate using session id and emitted checksums.

sasha: migration: for HTTP/3 clients that change connection or source CID, resume acceptance must require trace match + nonce validation. otherwise mark as stolen and refuse resume. also rate-limit resume attempts per API key.

omar: chunk granularity: to avoid duplicate chunk emission, handshake/stream frames include a 16-bit chunk seq. proxy keeps a compact per-session duplicate detector. full per-chunk state is heavy; use a small bloom filter per session with size tiered by customer plan. false positives -> AMBIG tag; false negatives are tuned low.

lee: tiering is good. default BF size 2048 bits, pro 8192, enterprise 65536. also have a hard memory cap per proxy process and soft-eviction policy.

anna: eviction behavior: in-process bounded LRU with write-through to memstore. default session TTL 45s, extend on activity. when evicted, session marked stale: proxy returns resume-status=stale in trailer and HTTP 410 for streaming clients.

omar: what header/trailer conventions are we standardizing? SDKs need simple deterministic signals.

anna: headers/trailers we propose: X-RW-Session: s=<id>;ttl=<s>; X-RW-Resume-Token: r=<token>;offset=<bytes>;compat=<tag>; X-RW-Nonce: n=<hmac>; X-RW-Trace: t=<id>. trailers: resume-status: accepted|partial|refused|stale|stolen; resume-reason: compat|capacity|stale; advice=restart|retry-after=<s>. additionally X-RW-Fallback header on responses if proxy routed to a different family.

sasha: for partial resumes, include X-RW-Partial-Offset in events so billing can charge only incremental tokens. also include final-checksum in token for integrity checks.

lee: compatibility semantics need to be strict: compat tag must reflect identical generation kernel or explicit runtime compatibility flag. if compat=none => proxy must refuse resume. if compat=v1 and runtime says compatible, accept. runtime publishes compatibility matrix.

omar: testing: add integration tests for resume into incompatible pool -> expect trailer resume-status: refused;reason=compat. tests for migration with changed CID expecting stolen event and audit.

anna: security: HMAC keys stored in KMS, proxies cache keys and rotate every 24h. support overlap window for 2 key versions. also throttle session create by API key + source IP; small token bucket per key.

sasha: observability: emit metric resume_outcome{result, tier, reason} and trace logs with X-RW-Trace. make resume_failure an alert when rate > baseline.

lee: UX: include X-RW-Warning: resumed-partial and X-RW-Resume-Window: <bytes> so SDKs can show degraded UI quickly without waiting for trailers. trailers still authoritative.

omar: last nit on memory: set hard per-process session memory and prefer memstore write-through for long-lived sessions. eviction produces 'stale' semantics not silent failure.

devops-bot: staging deploy: ingress-handshake-v1 queued, tests: resume-incompat and http3-migration scheduled.

anna: great. i'll update the RFC with: header/trailer contract, BF-based chunk dedupe, chunk seq, HMAC nonce semantics, tiered resume window sizes, LRU+memstore eviction and stale semantics, fallback routing header, metrics and tests. leave for 24h comment period.

lee: LGTM; i'll draft the integration test matrix.

omar: i'll own proxy bloom filter + LRU PR.

sasha: i'll do SDK docs for handling resume-status and warning headers.

devops-bot: scheduled test run completed: 0 failures. artifacts uploaded to CI.
